card.name: Inside PEDIATRIC and drug names
card.fires_on: Low values on the middle piece of a split word: "AT" inside capitalized PEDIATRIC, and "in" or "om" inside drug names like rufinamide and Ludiomil.

modes.label: PEDIATRIC in capitals

modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF SERIOUS DEHYDRATION IN PEDI<<AT>>RIC PATIENTS LESS THAN 2

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name, such as "in" in rufinamide or "om" in Ludiomil, in drug lists.
